parsed.change_summary: Changed the socket type from SOCK_RAW to SOCK_DGRAM and the protocol from IPPROTO_RAW to IPPROTO_UDP in the socket creation call.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger for CWE-77 is blocked because the use of SOCK_RAW with IPPROTO_RAW allows for the creation of raw sockets, which can potentially inject or manipulate OS commands. By changing the socket type to SOCK_DGRAM and the protocol to IPPROTO_UDP, the socket is now used for user datagram protocol (UDP), which does not involve the creation or manipulation of OS commands. This change ensures that the socket creation parameters are no longer susceptible to OS command injection.
parsed.behavior_changes: The behavior change is that the program now uses UDP instead of raw IP packets. This means it will not be able to send or receive raw IP packets, but it will be more secure against OS command injection vulnerabilities.
